summary: Cryptographic Provenance Certificate (PDF) end-to-end testing — backend endpoint + frontend trigger. All 11 new certificate tests pass; 20/21 existing security tests still pass (no regression). Audit chain remains valid (472 entries).
critical_code_review_comments: PDF generation runs synchronously inside the request thread via reportlab — fine for the SLA budget (~0.5s observed for 3 events / 1 file), but consider offloading to a thread pool (run_in_executor) once vaults grow beyond ~100 events/files to avoid blocking the event loop.

Certificate notarization (notarize_bytes) is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; if the request ends quickly, the task is still owned by the running event loop so this is OK in practice, but failures would only surface in backend logs — confirmed working: a new 'vault.certificate' proof IS created and is visible via /api/security/proofs.
filename uses listing.name lowercased & space-collapsed; works but underscores in listing names (e.g. 'TEST_Acme_eb2bb9') leak into filename — cosmetic only.
DealRoomDetail downloadCertificate uses room.listing_name slug (frontend) while backend uses listing.name + cert_id; cosmetic mismatch but both deliver valid PDFs.
